services.name: Rental Space For …
services.desc: Our beautiful 15,000 square foot building is available to rent for weddings, anniversaries, reunions, picnics, conferences, birthday parties, and more. The double vaulted ceiling creates a magical acoustic sound, making the space perfect for concerts, recitals, or drama productions. Our outdoor plaza area includes a BBQ and is a great addition for any spring or summer rental. Professional landscaping sets the perfect backdrop for anything from a picnic to pictures. Our facility can accommodate up to 300 people in row seating or 175 seated at tables. Rentals include the use of the sound system, modern stage lighting, screen and projector, tables, chairs, and tableware. Host your next event

blurb: The Gem of the West Museum is celebrating 25 years since its official grand opening, and we want to celebrate by bringing together the people who have been part of the museum's story. Over the past 25 years, countless people have helped make the museum what it is today - volunteers, board members, staff, donors, supporters, and community members.
